capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Guide Auto (Canada): the larger pack is 77 kWh (all AWD Sport/GT; FWD Long Range 480 km car also the larger pack); Drive Tesla Canada: Uncharted 77 kWh. Subaru US states 74.7 kWh for all trims (conflict, as on the Solterra).
Subaru USA release: 74.7 kWh on all trims (conflicts with the Canadian 77 kWh).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Same 74.7 kWh pack as the 2026 bZ (Subaru US release), whose chief engineer says the pack keeps the same NMC chemistry and cells (Autopian).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists 391 V for the 74.7 kWh pack; Toyota chief engineer (InsideEVs) says 400-volt architecture; the Subaru twin uses the 74.7 kWh pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Uncharted release says the "battery preconditioning system" is shared with the 2026 Solterra and Trailseeker; the Trailseeker kit (id 2400) says it starts by navigating to a charger or from the touchscreen. The Uncharted trigger itself is not spelled out.

ac_max_kw.notes: Drive Tesla Canada: 11 kW onboard charger.
